factuality.passWhen: Every required fact is stated without a contradiction or unsupported substitution.
factuality.failWhen: Any required fact is contradicted or replaced with an unsupported claim.

completeness.passWhen: Every required fact for the case is present.

citationSupport.passWhen: Every required fact has at least one cited 1-indexed inclusive range containing its supporting source line.
citationSupport.failWhen: Any required fact lacks a supporting citation or any citation is out of the supplied source range.

contract.passWhen: The exact declared status and handling are returned without raw-result substitution, retry, or language score for contract-only cases.
contract.failWhen: The declared handling changes, raw data is substituted, an implicit retry occurs, or a contract-only case receives a language score.

rubric.contractOnlyCasePass: contract=1; factuality, completeness, and citationSupport are not applicable

cases.repeatExpectation: Both repetitions have the same required fact and citation support.
